name: afford-agent
description: Answers whether a user can afford a purchase right now, based on their spending profile and live product pricing.

skills.name: Affordability Check
skills.description: Determines whether a purchase is affordable right now based on spending patterns and live pricing, with a natural-language explanation.
examples: Can I afford a ₹45,000 laptop right now?
Should I buy a ₹12,000 phone this month?
Can I afford a Dell Inspiron 15 3530?
